url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I can’t pull live data from Amazon for you. However, I can walk you through how to find the price and shipping policy for the Galaxy S24 on Amazon yourself:

| Step | What to do | Tips |
|------|------------|------|
| 1 | **Open Amazon** – Go to www.amazon.com (or your local Amazon site). | Use a browser that’s logged into your Amazon account so you’ll see the most accurate shipping options. |
| 2 | **Search for “Galaxy S24”** – Type it into the search bar and hit Enter. | If there are multiple models (e.g., 5G, 5G Plus), choose the one you’re interested in. |
| 3 | **Select the product listing** – Click on the Galaxy S24 that matches the description you want. | Look for the official Samsung listing or a reputable seller. |
| 4 | **Check the price** – The price is displayed prominently under the product title. | Prices may vary by seller, so note whether it’s sold by Amazon or a third‑party vendor. |
| 5 | **Find shipping details** – Scroll down to the “Shipping” section or look for a “Free Shipping” badge. | If you’re not logged in, Amazon will often show “Estimated delivery” dates once you add the item to your cart. |
| 6 | **Add to cart (optional)** – Add the item to your cart to see the exact shipping cost and estimated delivery window. | If you’re not ready to buy, you can still add it to the cart to view shipping options without purchasing. |
| 7 | **Review shipping policy** – In the cart, click “View shipping options” or “See all shipping options.” | This will list free shipping, expedited shipping, and any additional fees. |

### Quick Tips for Accurate Shipping Info

- **Prime Membership**: If you’re an Amazon Prime member, many items qualify for free two‑day shipping. Look for the Prime badge next to the price.
- **Seller Shipping**: Items sold by third‑party sellers may have different shipping times and costs. The seller’s name appears next to the price.
- **Delivery Estimates**: Amazon often shows an estimated delivery date range (e.g., “Delivered by 12/15”). Hover over or click the date for more details.

### If You Want Automated Data

If you need this information programmatically, consider using Amazon’s **Product Advertising API** (PAAPI). You’ll need to:

1. Sign up for an Amazon Associates account.
2. Create an access key and secret key.
3. Use the PAAPI SDK (available in several languages) to query product details, including price and shipping options.

> **Note:** Scraping Amazon pages directly (e.g., via web scraping scripts) violates Amazon’s Terms of Service and can result in IP bans or legal action. Always use the official API when possible.

Let me know if you’d like help setting up the PAAPI or if you have any other questions!
